newsitem.title: USA: First American names Zingg president.
newsitem.headline: First American names Zingg president.

text.p: First American Bank in Rosemead, California said Tuesday it has appointed Robert Zingg as president and chief operating officer.
Zingg succeeded Bill O'Mara who remains with the bank as chairman and chief executive officer.
Zingg has over 20 years of banking experience and has served as president for two other independent banks in California during the last eight years.

First American Bank, which suffered heavy losses during the past few years, has been operating under a formal agreement with the Federal Reserve Bank since 1992. Zingg's immediate plans are to strengthen the banks credit administration and reduce non-performing assets.
